About Us

What if your work could drive change in a globally established industry, shaping processes that touch every corner of the world? At Forto, we are at the forefront of change, harnessing the power of AI to revolutionise logistics. We want to reinvent digital supply chains to be transparent, frictionless and sustainable. From day one, our mission has been to simplify global trade – creating a seamless and efficient logistics process.

Your Role & Mission

The mission of the Flash team at Forto is to fundamentally redesign operations processes by leveraging automation and intelligent decision-making to handle shipments more efficiently. We aim to scale CoPilot so that it becomes the primary system used by operations managers, enabling them to be more effective and efficient in their daily work.

As a Senior Software Engineer in the Flash team, you will help build AI-driven solutions and the CoPilot that powers our logistics operations. You will maintain and evolve a sophisticated event-driven, distributed architecture designed to answer one key question:

How do we improve shipment handling and bring efficiency to our operations teams at scale?

From quotation and rate management, to shipment execution and schedule optimization (capacity utilization and GP optimization), to carrier integrations and automated data extraction from unstructured sources (emails, PDFs, spreadsheets), this role focuses on building reliable, data-heavy systems that directly impact revenue and operational performance.

What you will do

- Design, build, and evolve scalable and resilient backend systems
- Contribute to an event-driven, distributed architecture
- Work on AI-adjacent systems (integration, orchestration, data-heavy workflows)
- Own services end-to-end (design, implementation, documentation, operation)
- Collaborate closely with product managers, operations, and other engineers
- Communicate clearly with stakeholders and explain technical trade-offs
- Contribute to technical standards and best practices within the team
- Foster a culture of excellence by coaching team members in best practices for backend engineering, domain-driven design, and navigating the complexities of the logistics domain.

Required Skills and Experience

- Strong grasp of data structures, algorithms, and complexity analysis, particularly as they apply to large-scale data processing and financial calculations.
- Proven professional software craftsmanship, with a focus on building high-quality, maintainable, and testable code (an understanding of TDD is a plus).
- Expertise in designing and implementing large-scale, event-driven microservices architectures and robust APIs, with a keen understanding of data consistency in distributed systems.
- Deep understanding of synchronous vs. asynchronous communication patterns and their impact on system performance and reliability
- Hands-on experience developing distributed backend applications, with a strong focus on data consistency, system quality, low latency, and high availability.
- Proficiency in microservices, with hands-on experience in backend technologies such as Node.js, TypeScript, and MongoDB.
- Familiarity with Kubernetes and container orchestration for deploying and managing scalable pricing services.
- Experience with cloud providers (AWS or GCP preferred) for deploying and managing highly available and scalable applications.
- A collaborative, team-oriented mindset with strong critical product thinking and a sense of ownership over the accuracy and effectiveness of pricing data.
- Fluent in English, both verbal and written, for effective communication within a global team.

Preferred Skills and Experience

- Experience integrating AI/LLM-powered features into user faced applications
- Experience applying Domain-Driven Design (DDD) in complex product domains

Don’t fit all of our criteria? That’s okay! We know that you might be hesitant to apply if you don’t meet all our requirements, but here at Forto, we pride ourselves on embracing diverse perspectives and celebrating potential. If you are passionate about this position and the Forto values, please apply anyway. There could be a place for you in this role – or another one that’s a perfect fit! 

Why work with us?

Our team is hard-working, constantly seeking to maximise the impact of their work, but we put our people first, always winning with care. We value efficient systems and swift, direct communication. We want everyone to have their time to speak, so that we can embrace diverse perspectives to help drive towards solutions always.

jobs.occupation: Senior Partner Development Manager – Distribution Partners Germany, EMEA Partner Organization (Betriebswirt/in - allgemeine Betriebswirtschaft)
jobs.employer_name: Amazon Web Services EMEA SARL Niederlassung Deutschland
jobs.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking an experienced Distribution Partner Development Manager to own and drive the AWS distribution strategy across Germany. In this role, you will manage and grow strategic relationships with our Authorised Distribution Partners such as Ingram Micro and TD Synnex, particularly for SMB and Enterprise customers. An additional area of responsibility is to grow the business with large value added resellers (“Systemhäuser”, e.g. Bechtle, Cancom) across Enterprise and Public Sector Accounts.

The AWS Distribution Program enables our distributors to act as force multipliers — leveraging their deep partner relationships, market knowledge, and specialised expertise to extend the reach of AWS solutions to customers we cannot efficiently serve through direct channels alone. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role that requires a rare blend of strategic thinking, commercial acumen, and operational discipline. You will not only execute on strategy — you will shape it, acting as the voice of distribution into AWS program design discussions and influencing worldwide policy decisions where distribution-specific considerations are required.

As the single-threaded owner of the German distribution channel, you will serve as the primary interface between AWS and our distributors, driving incremental revenue through their reseller communities. You will work cross-functionally with AWS sales, partner, marketing, and solutions architecture teams to accelerate cloud adoption at scale, particularly within the SMB Commercial Sector.

Key job responsibilities
Partner Management & Strategy
• Own end-to-end relationships with Authorised Distribution and Systemhaus Partners in Germany.
• Develop and execute joint business plans aligned to AWS go-to-market and EMEA strategy.
• Drive QBRs and cadence meetings with partner leadership at VP/CXO level.
• Grow distributor-attributed and AWS Marketplace revenue YoY.
• Pursue new routes-to-market and "Power of Three" collaboration.

Revenue & Performance Management
• Own revenue targets for the German channel, including resell and influenced revenue.
• Monitor distributor performance: revenue, recruitment, enablement, pipeline.
• Produce monthly partner reports from internal dashboards.
• Analyse trends, flag risks/opportunities, drive action plans.
• Track Partner Attributed Revenue and ensure accurate attribution.

Program Design & Execution
• Act as the voice of distribution into AWS program design discussions, representing field-level feedback on attribution models, incentive structures, and partner programs.
.
• Ensure distributors are enabled on launches and policy changes.

Enablement & Ecosystem Growth
• Recruit, onboard, and activate new resellers into the channel.
• Align with PDMs and Account Managers across direct, distribution, and "Power of Three" motions.
• Drive technical enablement (AI, Migration, Data & Analytics); support co-sell/co-marketing.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Align Germany execution with EMEA Scale & Distribution strategy.
• Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Partner Solutions Architects, Operations.

About the team
The Distribution team sits within the Amazon Partner Organisation in Germany & Europe Central, focused on extending AWS's reach through established distributor communities to serve the Commercial Sector at scale. You'll be part of a collaborative, high-performing team that values customer obsession, partner obsession, and execution excellence.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level
- Experience presenting to both technical and non-technical executive audiences
- Minimum 6 years of channel experience, with specific distribution, indirect channel or reselling background
- German and English business fluent
- Cloud and/or digital transformation experience — understanding of cloud business models, consumption economics, and partner ecosystems
- Proven ability to manage breadth over depth — portfolio management across 30+ partners through leverage and prioritisation
- Strong commercial acumen: pipeline management, forecasting, and revenue accountability
- Demonstrated stakeholder management across complex, matrixed organisations

Preferred Qualifications

- Direct experience with IT distribution (Ingram Micro, TD SYNNEX, Arrow, ALSO) or Systemhaus channel (Bechtle, Cancom, Computacenter)
- AWS or hyperscaler partner programme experience
- Experience with CRM systems and pipeline analytics (Salesforce preferred)
- Understanding of software marketplace transaction models and cloud procurement
- Track record of building new coverage models or channel motions from scratch
- Familiarity with German SMB and mid-market IT landscape

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build.

jobs.occupation: Senior Solution Architect IT/OT Security Platforms (f/m/d) (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
jobs.description:
Siemens IT enables secure, reliable and scalable digital services for Siemens businesses and factories worldwide. Within IT IPS, we develop and operate services that support the transformation of industrial environments towards modern, secure and standardized IT/OT operations.
As a Solution Architect for our IT/OT Security Platforms you will define the technical vision and architecture for strategic service offerings. You will work closely with factories, cybersecurity experts, service managers, product teams, and technology partners to design scalable, secure, and future-ready solutions that support Siemens' Zero Trust and digitalization strategy. Our OT Zero Trust Platform enables secure IT/OT communication through identity-based connectivity concepts, while our OT Patch Management enables centralized endpoint management, patching, hardening and compliance for enterprise and production-related devices.

What we offer you
At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well-being at every stage of your career. From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and development opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.

You'll make an impact by

- You design and evolve the target architecture for our IT/OT Security - ManageEngine, ensuring alignment with Siemens cybersecurity, operational, and business requirements.- You define secure IT/OT communication concepts based on Zero Trust principles and develop architectures for remote access, machine connectivity, application communication, and future AI-driven use cases.- You support Siemens factories in integrating modern security and management solutions into existing brownfield environments, considering legacy systems, industrial protocols, and operational constraints.- You translate business, security, and operational requirements into scalable platform architectures, governance models, technical standards, and implementation roadmaps.- You collaborate with factories, cybersecurity teams, service owners, vendors, and technology partners to establish architecture standards and drive service adoption across Siemens.- You define integration concepts between connectivity services, endpoint management platforms, monitoring solutions, automation frameworks, and enterprise systems.- You evaluate new technologies and architecture patterns and contribute to the continuous evolution of Siemens' IT/OT security and platform landscape.- You enable data-driven and AI-supported operational use cases by designing architectures that support secure data flows, automation, analytics, and platform interoperability.- You actively shape the journey to AI-native OT security services.

This is how you'll win us over

- Education: You have a university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a comparable qualification.- Experience and Skills:- You possess strong expertise in Zero Trust and OT Security Architecture, including concepts such as identity-centric networking, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, and industry frameworks such as NIST SP 800-207 and IEC 62443.- You have long years of experience ( 5 + ) with OT Infrastructure and Brownfield Integration (of at least 3+ years), including industrial environments, legacy systems, machine-to-machine communication, industrial protocols, network segmentation, and hybrid IT/OT architectures.- You bring solid knowledge of Endpoint, Asset and Service Management Architectures, including endpoint management, asset discovery, software deployment, patch management, CMDB, and IT service management platforms.- You are experienced in Platform and Enterprise Architecture (of at least 3+ years) and can translate business and security requirements into scalable technical solutions, governance models, operating concepts, and technology roadmaps.- You possess strong capabilities in Platform Integration, Automation, AI and Analytics, including API-based integration, monitoring, automation, operational data flows, and AI-ready platform design.- You have 3-5 years of experience with ManageEngine or similar technologies.
- Ways of Working: - You are able to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and successfully align diverse stakeholder groups.- You work in a structured and strategic manner and are comfortable operating in international and cross-functional environments.- You provide your support during Central European Time Zone (CET).
- Languages: Fluent English skills complete your profile. German language skills are beneficial.

jobs.description:
What to Expect

Please submit your CV in English in order to be considered for the role.Tesla is accelerating the transition to sustainable energy with our industry-leading Residential Energy Products, including Powerwall, Wall Connector, Solar, and the full Residential Energy Ecosystem. These products are already deployed in over 40 countries, with fleets growing exponentially as more partners include them in their projects and installations.The Residential Systems Diagnostics Team uses critical thinking and deep product knowledge to deliver best-in-class, engineer-level support for Tesla’s residential storage and home charging products. As an Associate Systems Diagnostics Engineer, you’ll troubleshoot medium-to-high complexity technical issues, support internal engineering and field teams, and go deep on proprietary power electronics and energy systems. You thrive on challenging edge cases, balance detailed problem-solving with big-picture thinking, and excel in fast-paced, collaborative environments.This role is available in Amsterdam and Berlin.

What You’ll Do

- Own and resolve technical cases from internal engineering, technical, and field service teams via ticketing, email, and live chat
- Troubleshoot proprietary power electronics systems, metering, communications, and supporting components
- Use CLI tools (Linux, SSH, SCP, VI) to connect to devices, pull logs, and edit configurations
- Read and interpret single-line diagrams for PV, storage, load, and meter configurations
- Handle VIP and corporate white-glove escalations with urgency and precision
- Partner with engineering teams on root cause analysis (RCA) and emerging issue tracking (JIRA)
- Document cases thoroughly and identify process or knowledge gaps to improve training and resources
- Deliver internal and external upskilling/training sessions

What You’ll Bring

- Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, or a related technical field, or 3+ years in a Technical Support Engineering role
- Strong understanding of electrical theory, AC/DC power systems, metering, energy flow, power factor, and phase rotation
- Experience troubleshooting complex technical issues involving multiple variables (metering, communications, distributed generation/storage preferred)
- Proficiency with Linux command line (SSH, SCP, VI) and comfort learning proprietary systems quickly
- Experience with SQL, Python, or AI tools is beneficial
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills – able to explain complex technical topics clearly
- Strong case management discipline: prioritization, detailed documentation, and follow-up
- Experience with CRM tools and MS Office
- Fluent in English; additional European languages are a plus
- Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with engineering and cross-functional teams
- Genuine curiosity for energy products and willingness to go deep on new technology

Tesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

Tesla is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the interview process.

Privacy is a top priority for Tesla. We build it into our products and view it as an essential part of our business. To understand more about the data we collect and process as part of your application, please view our Tesla Talent Privacy Notice.

At Lexxion we are proud to serve as a specialist publisher for all stakeholders within the European Union. Based in Berlin, we offer legal journals, books, conferences and professional training in areas such as European data protection law, State aid, defence, and artificial intelligence law.

We are looking for a full-time Executive Editor (m/f/d) to join our editorial team, starting 1 January 2027. This is a 1-year fixed-term position to provide maternity cover. The Editor will be in charge of Lexxion’s portfolio of publications in the fields of AI law, data protection law and food law.

Tasks

- Management of legal journals: desk reviews, editing, formatting and typesetting of manuscripts; liaising with authors, reviewers and editorial team; planning content, setting and adhering to production deadlines.
- Keeping abreast of developments in relevant legal and policy areas; pro-actively curating the journals to reflect interesting developments in the focus areas.
- Creating and implementing outreach and business development initiatives to increase the visibility of the journals (in conjunction with Lexxion's marketing team).
- Developing ideas for and supporting the planning of trainings and conferences with our conference managers.

Requirements

- Strong interest in European and international law and policy.
- Bachelor’s degree or higher in EU law/affairs, international law/affairs or related fields.
- 1+ years of prior professional experience.
- Excellent planning, management and interpersonal skills.
- Comfortable interacting with high-level professionals and experts.
- Demonstrates meticulous attention to detail coupled with strategic, big-picture thinking.
- A background in the specific journal topics is an advantage, but not a requirement.
- Previous experience in the publishing sector will be highly valued.Excellent written and spoken English (native speaker or equivalent). Some German language skills would be helpful for everyday exchange with colleagues, but are not a must

Benefits

- Opportunity to expand your network and editorial experience, working closely with leading experts from various domains in a dynamic, internationally focused publishing house.
- Supportive professional environment with a flat hierarchy which fosters self-initiative and provides the freedom to transform ideas into reality.
- Regular EU-wide business travel and attendance of leading events in relevant fields.
- 1-year fixed-term contract for maternity cover, starting 1 January 2027, alongside a competitive salary commensurate with the applicant’s experience and qualifications.
- The position is based in Berlin, Germany.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

1. Introduction Chat (30 min; via telephone or MS Teams)
Objective: Both parties gain a first impression, discuss the company, the position, and the team; share your experience, interest in and qualification for the position; address questions about the role and the company.
2. Test Assignment (1 hour; remote; unpaid)
Objective: Demonstrate your ability to do a task that will be part of your work as Executive Editor.
3. Test Assignment Q&A, Line Manager and CEO Interview (1.5 hours; in person at Lexxion’s office in Berlin-Wilmersdorf)
Objective: Give and receive feedback on your test assignment; discuss your qualifications, motivation, professional goals and fit with the company culture; talk in more depth about the position, the immediate and extended team you will be collaborating with; explore your management and interpersonal skills; discuss salary and onboarding process; possibly meet some relevant Lexxion employees.
4. Offer Talk
Objective: Present our offer; agree on start date; discuss the onboarding process.

First Research Article Fellowship Program at the Max Planck Institute for the History

of Science, Berlin

01 September 2027 – 28 February 2028

The Max Planck Institute for the History of Science ( MPIWG) is offering six-month

fellowships for outstanding graduate students enrolled in doctoral programs based at

Asian, African, or Latin American institutions.

Applicants should demonstrate their commitment to a research topic related to the history of

science, technology, and medicine, or science and technology studies, and a need to work

with an international community at the MPIWG in order to prepare and publish their first

single-authored research paper in English.

First Research Article Fellows will be hosted in one of the following departments:

• Artefacts, Action, Knowledge (AAK – Director: Prof. Dr. Dagmar Schäfer)

• Knowledge Systems and Collective Life (KSCL – Director: Prof. Dr. Etienne Benson)

Regular meetings will be held to support both the writing process and academic

development. Fellows are welcome and encouraged to take part in activities offered by the

Institute and by the International Max Planck Research School “Knowledge and Its

Resources” that take place on our campus.

Candidates are expected to have already completed the relevant research for their thesis and

be in a position to devote six months to writing and preparing an article in English for

journal publication. Fellows must remain enrolled in their home institution’s doctoral

program through the end of the advertised fellowship period.

Fellowships are endowed with a monthly stipend according to the guidelines of the Max

Planck Society (https://www.mpiwg-berlin.mpg.de/research/projects/first-research-article-

fellowship).

Applicants should submit the following materials in English through our online application

portal:

1. Cover letter explaining how the applicant’s proposed research fits the research

themes of one specific department

1. Official enrollment certificate and confirmation that the applicant will remain

enrolled in an accredited graduate program (PhD) through the end of the

fellowship

1. 500-word description of the dissertation written by the applicant
2. Curriculum vitae (preferably without a photograph) including any publications if

applicable

1. Title, abstract, and outline of article to be completed during the fellowship

(maximum 750 words)

1. English-language writing sample (maximum 8000 words including notes and

bibliography) written by the applicant7. A letter of recommendation from one supervisor

This program is intended to support scholars who wish to improve their academic English.

We encourage you to write your application without the use of AI.

The Max Planck Institute for the History of Science encourages applications from qualified

individuals who belong to groups that are often underrepresented in the workplace due to age,

disability, ethnicity, family status, gender, nationality, race, sex, sexual orientation,

socioeconomic background, or religion.

Please note that only electronic submissions will be accepted. Applications must be

uploaded to the following link on or before 15 January 2027 (23:59 CET):

https://recruitment.mpiwg-berlin.mpg.de/position/36470793

Finalists may expect a decision by 1 April 2027.

Descriptions of the research projects undertaken by the departments can be found here:

https://www.mpiwg-berlin.mpg.de/research/department/artifacts-action-knowledge

Knowledge Systems and Collective Life (KSCL):

https://www.mpiwg-berlin.mpg.de/research/department/knowledge-systems-collective-life

For further information, please consult the Frequently Asked Questions at the program’s

website: https://www.mpiwg-berlin.mpg.de/research/projects/first-research-article-

fellowship.
